content:
zoe: Heads-up: Neighbor company dropping off a large potted fern (gift swap) + two shallow crates of vinyl records for a listening session at 4pm. Need visitor badge, short bench for unboxing, and a parking pass for the courier van.

frontdesk-bot: Visitor scheduled: 1 courier + 1 guest (gift), ETA 15:50. Host: zoe. Check-in link: https://intranet/checkin/park123

rafael: For the plant: please check pot drip tray and that it's not muddy. We don't want watering on lobby floor. Could Facilities put down a sheet if they need to open crate?

priya: Vinyl crates are fragile  courier says "fragile: records" and wants to leave them in lobby for 20 mins while host signs. Can facilities hold them in Conference B?

ops: Ops: Conference B ok for short-term holding. We'll put an A-frame and keep crate upright. Parking pass: we have a one-hour short-term vendor pass, I'll add it to the courier's check-in.

zoe: Thanks. Can front desk add note on badge: "Fragile items: handle upright" and put a cone around the unboxing area? Also please ask courier to avoid leaving soil/tray.

frontdesk-bot: Badge note added. Temporary cone placed request sent to facilities.

sam: PSA: if anyone plans a listening party with records, please avoid glitter confetti. Records + glitter = pain. :grimacing:

priya: Also quick FYI re: plant allergens  someone on team is sensitive to ficus. Zoe, can you confirm species?

zoe: It's a Boston fern per sender. I'll confirm. If allergic, we'll keep plant in Conference B for an hour then move to a low-traffic corner.

rafael: I'll bring a washable drop-cloth and a small tray for the pot. Facilities will be at reception at 15:50 to escort crate and move plant if needed.

zoe: Perfect. Sending courier the parking pass and asking them to wear masks while inside. Thanks everyone :raised_hands:
